verses.text: As far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verses.title: Radiating God’s Goodness

verses.text: Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour. Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that the family of believers throughout the world is undergoing the same kind of sufferings.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
